observations: Actual three-camera keyframes show the stemmed glass upright on its support in front of the oven. The robot approaches beside the glass, grasps the original oven handle, pulls and releases. The glass and pillar remain upright in the sampled external frames. Both external views and wrist RGB contain normal scene content; the close wrist view rotates with the tool during the pull. This sample check does not certify every frame or dismiss the renderer shutdown log.
review_scope: Sampled actual recorded RGB frames, not every frame.
